extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is an 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover used for?
faqs.a: This API 6A adapter flange adapts an 11" 10K workover BOP stack down to a 7-1/16" 10K production wellhead. It is a single-piece flanged crossover, bolted with two BX gaskets and no studs, used on workover campaigns on producing wells and through-tubing intervention stack-ups.

faqs.q: What are the end connections of the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover?
faqs.a: It has an API 6A 11" 10K flanged top and a 7-1/16" 10K flanged bottom, in an adapter-flange crossover design with a 7-1/16" bore. Approximate transport weight is 580 kg. Confirm both flange sizes on the RFQ against your BOP stack and wellhead.

faqs.q: Which ring gaskets does the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover take?
faqs.a: The 11" 10K end takes a BX-158 ring and the 7-1/16" 10K end takes a BX-156. They are supplied in soft iron for sweet service or Inconel-625-clad for sour service; see [ring joint gaskets](/c/ring-joint-gaskets) and [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts).

faqs.q: What OEM crossovers is the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover equivalent to?
faqs.a: It is listed as equivalent to the Cameron adapter flange 11" x 7-1/16" 10K and the FMC adapter flange, as a standard workover stack-to-wellhead crossover. Indus Hydraulics is not an authorised distributor of these OEMs, and each unit is supplied with full traceability.

faqs.q: What does the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover connect to?
faqs.a: It connects an 11" 10K preventer, such as an [11" 10K annular BOP](/p/annular-bop-hydril-gk-style-11-10-000-psi-wp-sour-service-nace-mr0175), to a 7-1/16" 10K production wellhead. See [wellhead equipment](/c/wellhead) for the wellhead side and confirm the flange type on your drawing.

faqs.q: Where is the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover used?
faqs.a: It is used on workover BOP stack to production wellhead crossovers, on Aramco, ADNOC and KOC workover campaigns on producing wells, on through-tubing intervention stack-ups and for snubbing preparation on production wellheads.

faqs.q: When should I choose a crossover flange instead of a DSA or drilling spool?
faqs.a: Choose this single-piece flanged crossover when the stack steps down from 11" to 7-1/16" and both faces are flanged. The [13-5/8" x 11" DSA](/p/double-studded-adapter-dsa-13-5-8-10k-11-10k-api-6a-sour-service-nace-mr0175) has two studded faces instead of a flange, and the [13-5/8" drilling spool](/p/drilling-spool-13-5-8-10k-13-5-8-10k-api-6a-sour-service-nace-mr0175) adds choke and kill outlets.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover?
faqs.a: The 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover is rated 10,000 psi cold working pressure, 10K class. Every unit gets a hydrostatic shell test at 1.5 times rated working pressure, which is a test figure and not an operating limit. The temperature rating is -20°F to 180°F (-29°C to 82°C).

faqs.q: Is the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover suitable for sour (H2S) service?
faqs.a: Yes, the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover is listed as sour service to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156. The forged AISI 4130 alloy steel body has hardness controlled to a maximum of 22 HRC and is Charpy V-notch tested at low temperature. Give H2S partial pressure and chloride content on the RFQ for final material sign-off.

faqs.q: What API and certification documents come with the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover?
faqs.a: The 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover is API 6A, supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed unit from an API-licensed manufacturer, with the API certificate and monogram documentation supplied with the order. It also carries EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports, a hydrostatic test certificate and heat-number traceability stamped on the body.

faqs.a: The listing states a lead time of 45 days for the 11" 10K x 7-1/16" 10K adapter flange crossover. Exact timing depends on configuration and certification scope and is confirmed on the RFQ. Export orders ship on the lane stated for the destination.

faqs.q: What is a 13-5/8" 10K x 11" 10K double studded adapter (DSA) used for?
faqs.a: A double studded adapter adapts a 13-5/8" 10K BOP stack down to an 11" 10K wellhead, the typical workover-on-development-wellhead arrangement. Both faces are studded with no flange face, which saves vertical height compared with a spool.

faqs.q: What are the end connections of the 13-5/8" 10K x 11" 10K double studded adapter (DSA)?
faqs.a: It has an API 6A 13-5/8" 10K studded top and an 11" 10K studded bottom, in a double studded adapter design with an 11" bore. Approximate transport weight is 950 kg. Confirm both sizes and the stud pattern on the RFQ against your BOP and wellhead.

faqs.q: What is a 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool used for?
faqs.a: The drilling spool is the choke and kill connection point of a 13-5/8" 10K BOP stack. It sits below the bottom ram and above the wellhead, with two 3-1/16" 10K side outlets for connecting the choke and kill manifold, and is required on every 13-5/8" 10K stack.

faqs.q: What are the end connections of the 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool?
faqs.a: It has API 6A 13-5/8" 10K flanged top and flanged bottom connections, with two 3-1/16" 10K flanged side outlets for the choke and kill lines. Approximate transport weight is 1,800 kg. Confirm the outlet orientation on your stack-up drawing.

faqs.q: Which ring gaskets does the 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool take?
faqs.a: The 13-5/8" 10K flanges take BX-159 rings and the 3-1/16" 10K side outlets take BX-154. They are supplied in soft iron for sweet service or Inconel-625-clad for sour service; see [ring joint gaskets](/c/ring-joint-gaskets) and [BOP spare parts](/c/bop-spare-parts).

faqs.q: What OEM drilling spools is the 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool equivalent to?
faqs.a: It is listed as equivalent to the Cameron, FMC and Stream-Flo drilling spools at 13-5/8" 10K, interchangeable on standard surface stack-ups. Indus Hydraulics is not an authorised distributor of these OEMs, and each unit is supplied with full traceability.

faqs.q: What connects to the side outlets of the 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool?
faqs.a: The two 3-1/16" 10K side outlets connect to the choke and kill manifold. See the [3-1/16" 10K choke and kill manifold](/p/choke-kill-manifold-3-1-16-10-000-psi-wp-api-16c-sour-service-nace-mr0175) and [choke and kill manifolds](/c/bop-choke-kill) for the matching equipment.

faqs.q: Where is the 13-5/8" 10K drilling spool used?
faqs.a: It is used for the choke and kill connection on 13-5/8" 10K wells, on mainstream Aramco, ADNOC and KOC development drilling, in sour-service drilling where the sour trim is the default, and as a replacement or upgrade for end-of-life drilling spools.

faqs.q: How does the drilling spool differ from a double studded adapter?
faqs.a: The spool carries two 3-1/16" 10K side outlets for choke and kill lines at 13-5/8" 10K both ends, while the [13-5/8" x 11" DSA](/p/double-studded-adapter-dsa-13-5-8-10k-11-10k-api-6a-sour-service-nace-mr0175) is a plain crossover with no side outlets.
